active.retention_class: ACTIVE: open databases/WAL; append only; never compress or move

warm.retention_class: WARM: immutable original segments; retain originals

cold.retention_class: COLD: verified additional compressed representations; originals retained

protected.retention_class: PROTECTED: account/forecast/audit and legacy evidence; preserve

catalog_state.retention_class: PROTECTED: append-only source identity/catalog and restart state

derived_cache.retention_class: DERIVED: existing verified cold cache; reproducible only with retained source proof

limitations: Net allocation includes WAL/cache/rotation changes; measure24h and7days
Compression adds verified copies; originals retained means no reclaimed bytes
Append-only catalogs grow even if a future original-retirement batch is approved
